tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List servable text chat models with USD prices (pricing.vs_list vs maker list price). Pass include=discovery to also see image/video models (servable:false). Filter by modality, max output price, text search; sort by popularity or price.

tools.name: list_trending
tools.description: Featured trending models with prices (ranked by recent tokens served when available, otherwise a curated ranking; see ranking field).

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the credit balance, spend cap and amount spent for a tai_ API key.

tools.name: create_topup
tools.description: Create a stablecoin top-up order. Returns the deposit address, chain and the exact amount to send. Omit api_key to create a new key (returned once).

tools.name: verify_topup
tools.description: Confirm a top-up after sending funds, by order id and transaction hash/signature. Credits the amount received (tolerance -0.5% or $0.01; other amounts need the sender's signature).

tools.name: claim_topup
tools.description: Credit a stablecoin transfer to our address that has no matching order (or a non-exact amount). Requires the sending wallet's signature of 'trustai.center claim <chain>:<tx_hash>'. Max 7 days old, each tx once. Omit api_key to get a new key.

tools.name: set_cap
tools.description: Set spend controls on a tai_ key: total spend cap, daily limit (UTC day) and per-request max, in USD. Omit a field to keep it, pass null to remove it.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Usage and audit log for a tai_ key: recent charges (model, tokens, cost), top-ups, last-24h totals, balance and limits.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Public platform stats from our database (tokens and requests in the last 24h, keys created, top models). Real numbers only.

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Run a chat completion billed to a tai_ key's credits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_models · Private data: list_trending, get_balance, claim_topup, get_usage, get_stats · Public sink: create_topup · Destructive: set_cap, chat_completion.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_models · Private data: list_trending, get_balance, claim_topup, get_usage, get_stats · Public sink: create_topup · Destructive: set_cap, chat_completion

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
